name: Sons of Cerberus
source:
You regain consciousness, confusion clouding your mind, memories mixed and hazy... Who are the four strangers you hear arguing?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你恢復了意識，卻滿腦子混亂，記憶模糊，攪成一團……你聽見四個陌生人在爭吵，他們是誰？

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
